title: Split oversized web Nostr helper modules

observed_behavior.summary: web/src/lib/nostr/nip07.js, nip46.js, and encrypted-controlplane.js were oversized compatibility/helper modules, making NIP-07, NIP-46, and encrypted ContextVM behavior harder to review.
evidence: Bead bahia-kw04 reported pre-existing line counts above the 200-line helper target.
The public import paths were used by existing code and tests and therefore had to remain compatible.

intended_behavior.summary: The public Nostr helper entry points remain stable while implementation is split into focused modules that preserve signing, NIP-44 encryption/decryption, ContextVM encrypted request publish verification, and event-driven result subscription semantics.
non_goals: No Nostr event kind, payload, signing, encryption, relay strategy, or user-facing behavior changes.
No relay-strategy documentation changes because another agent is concurrently updating those artifacts.

scope.docs: No documentation update required because this is an internal modularization with preserved public imports and no protocol/user-facing behavior change.
